opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions with research degree awarding powers (host academic staff member); some specialist arts institutions. Visitor is an eminent senior professor from overseas.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge in an underrepresented area of research.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other institutions of higher education, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations eligible by UKRI.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. Two-stage process; outline stage currently paused, detailed applications (invited applicants) close 1 September 2026.
discipline_tags: Broad/all subject areas except excluded areas

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £130,000 (Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one, 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000/year research expenses)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold doctorate by start; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work over 3 years at a UK university.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post at a UK university or eligible independent research organisation, with an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare results for publication. Application materials available from September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities holding research degree awarding powers in their own right; consortia of up to two universities.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to fund up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area, including additional support for underrepresented groups and postdoctoral opportunities.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers; may be single or multi-institution collaborations.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Centenary round expected to open February 2027 for outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Replacement salary costs for the duration, plus research expenses up to £6,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university (with research degree awarding powers).
opportunities.summary: For well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research, funded via replacement salary costs over 2-3 years.

opportunities.title: Centenary Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early-career scholars at lecturer level or equivalent at a UK university, with at least two years research/teaching experience after PhD, who have not yet led a research team.
opportunities.summary: For talented early-career scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. Centenary round opens January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except excluded areas

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Training Opportunities (Under 18s)

amount.raw: Up to £475,000 per institution, plus 5% administration contribution

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that can evidence outstanding quality teaching in the fine and performing arts.
opportunities.summary: For specialist arts institutions or registered charities to provide training opportunities across the fine and performing arts (music, drama, dance, film, fine art) for school-age children under 18.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Bursaries for Undergraduates and Postgraduates

amount.raw: Up to £475,000 per institution, plus 5% administration contribution; bursaries of £5,000-£10,000 per year per student

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities offering degrees at undergraduate or postgraduate taught level in the fine and performing arts.
opportunities.summary: For specialist arts institutions or registered charities to provide bursaries of £5,000 to £10,000 per year to support undergraduate and/or postgraduate students across the fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that will extend beyond the duration of the Fellowship; resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline, particularly those prevented by routine duties, to complete a piece of research over 3-24 months. Application materials available from September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research
